authority: none — measurement only; no rank/gate/size consumer

bases.basket_misses: equal-weight member returns over data/baskets/ohlcv with point-in-time dated membership — the basket machinery's own store and construction, NOT the breadth caches above (they are S&P-1500 and cannot see the off-index members the ignited baskets are full of).
bases.runner_eligibility: engine.confluence_tiers.tier_stream (completed buckets, raw-3D-cross T1 fallback) — last row = eligible_today, tail(63) = days_eligible/first_eligible. One basis for both so the verdict and the window cannot disagree about a day.
bases.universe_eligible_today: engine.confluence_tiers.cascade last bar, take_active=False (no §7 master supplied here) — a STRICTER set than the stream basis, which is why a runner can be stream-eligible and absent from it.
bases.board_gate: engine.signal_gate.gate per runner (gate_* fields) — the live board's own basis, over a narrower universe than the board's.
bases.name_score: engine.name_score_grader's append-only PIT call ledger, forward-joined through engine.grading (next-bar fill, survivorship-aware). Read-only: this audit mirrors the grader's numbers, it does not change what the grader computes.
bases.priority_score: engine.us_prophet_grades' full-population grade store (H=10/21 sessions, excess vs SPY, next-bar fill) joined to the priority score the US Context Vector store stamped for that name on that night. Read-only: this audit recomputes neither the score nor the grade. EVERY stamped name is graded, so a pick's hit is judged against that night's whole universe, not against the picks alone.

basket_misses.authority: none — measurement only; no rank/gate/size/membership consumer
basket_misses.basis: equal-weight member returns over data/baskets/ohlcv with point-in-time dated membership (engine.baskets._ew_level construction); the 10d return ranked inside the basket's OWN trailing 252-session history of the same measure. Overlapping windows — the percentile is a description, not a test.
basket_misses.miss_rule: pctile >= 0.9 AND zero live members on any of ['buy', 'watch', 'leaders', 'ran'] (featured is a flag inside buy)

name_score_scorecard.authority: none — read-only mirror of engine/name_score_grader outputs; no rank, gate, size, or user-facing consumer
name_score_scorecard.graded_by: engine.grading.grade_next_bar_return (next-bar fill, survivorship-aware) via engine.name_score_grader's own forward-store ladder
name_score_scorecard.scored_field: score — name_score.potential_score, the number the US board displays as conviction.score (scripts/build_stock_library.py overwrites c['score'] with the potential score for backward compatibility)

forward_store.note: the forward join resolves only names with a per-name close store; a stamped name with no store is absent from every horizon, not scored zero

precision_at_k.definition: hit = forward return > that stamp date's median graded forward return; dates with a graded cross-section < 20 are excluded from P@k (the exclusion is stated and counted below, not silent)

63d.null_reason: still accruing — 0 call(s) have 63 sessions of forward price past their next-bar fill; the grader reports 'accruing' below 5

scan_tier.floor_rule: still trading (last bar = store's last bar) AND >= 159 bars AND close >= $3 AND median(close x volume) over the last 20 bars >= $5M

priority_score_scorecard.authority: none — read-only join of two zero-authority stores; no rank, gate, size, board, plan or user-facing consumer
priority_score_scorecard.scored_field: prophet_score — the us_prophet_v1 priority score exactly as us_board_rank.score_rows stamped it that night (itemized legs sit beside it in the candidates store; no composite is built here)
priority_score_scorecard.graded_by: engine.us_prophet_grades — engine.grading.forward_metrics (next-bar fill, positional session horizons), excess vs SPY
priority_score_scorecard.population: EVERY stamped candidate row is graded, not only the ~12 that become plans (operator order 2026-08-05). Two populations are carried separately and never pooled: CURATED (board-admissible) and SCAN (seen and stamped, never admitted). Within each, basing and momentum picks are reported separately at every horizon in the ladder

store.null_reason: no grade rows yet — the store accrues prospectively from the first nightly after merge; H=10 rows mature ~11 sessions after a stamp, H=21 rows ~22

priority_score_scorecard.null_reason: no graded rows yet — the grade store accrues prospectively from the first nightly after merge (H=10 marks land ~11 sessions after a stamp, H=21 ~22). An absent record is not a null result

degraded.reason: carries asof+subsectors — no theme-level emerging_score rank, so the top-5 entry date is not recoverable from this archive; days_since_top5_entry reported null rather than approximated from the subsector unit (masterplan W2 owns the theme-level PIT rank archive)

1 basket(s) missing at least one member close while still reading at or above 60%: silver_miners — EW read over the members present, per-basket counts on each row's n_members_read. Disclosed rather than paged: a single unfetched member is a standing fact, and an annotation that fires every night is noise
